Title: The Martian
Author: Andy Weir
My Review: This book is fantastic. Period. It's one of the most gripping science fiction novels that I've read in quite some time, and in a lot of ways it reminds me a lot of the structure of 2001: A Space Odyssey. The book based around an astronaut that ends up stranded on Mars (a story that has been told a thousand times, I know) and his struggle to survive. But what this book does differently is that it uses actual science. It takes place in the present (think Mars One, 2030 Mars missions, etc), incorporates NASA politics, and just does a great job of telling the story from every relevant angle. Five out of five. Read it.
